message.content: The kernel's rational-approximation coefficients are heavily rounded (e.g., -16.16, 75.01, 24.86 vs Cephes full-precision constants), and the contract demands 1e-6 absolute accuracy over all finite FP16 values — a single violating value decides the verdict. I'll record the two highest-risk testable claims.

function.arguments: {"rationale": "Cephes double-precision coefficients are full 17-digit constants; here they are truncated to 4-5 significant digits, and each coefficient perturbation of ~1e-2..1e-4 in a degree-4/5 rational form propagates absolute error of order 1e-6..1e-5 in atan(r), so worst-case error over 65536 finite FP16 values plausibly exceeds the 1e-6 tolerance; the design is fully enumerable so a single violating value decides the verdict.", "scope": "in_scope", "scope_evidence": [{"source": "problem.txt", "summary": "Every finite FP16 value is legal and every output element must satisfy abs(actual[i] - atan(x[i])) <= 1e-6 with rtol=0; approximations are permitted only if the bound holds throughout the entire legal domain, and correctness is one verdict for the implementation."}], "scope_rationale": "The contract requires abs(output - atan(x)) <= 1e-6 for EVERY finite FP16 value in [−65504, 65504], so any representable FP16 input whose output error exceeds 1e-6 is a decisive in-scope violation.", "statement": "The rounded-coefficient FP32 rational approximation in _atan_kernel produces worst-case absolute error greater than 1e-6 for at least one finite FP16 input value (e.g., in the |x|<=0.66 or middle interval), violating the contract's absolute tolerance."}
function.name: record_claim

function.arguments: {"rationale": "For |x| just above 2.414213562373095 the reciprocal reduction makes reduced tiny; adding local_angle (~small) to pi/2 in FP32 rounds to the FP32 grid with spacing ~1.2e-7 near 1.57, which alone is near the tolerance, and approximation error in local_angle can push combined error over 1e-6. Also FP16 grid values immediately around the boundary may land on branches with differing error.", "scope": "in_scope", "scope_evidence": [{"source": "problem.txt", "summary": "The domain includes both extrema +/-65504 and all finite FP16 values, with abs(actual[i] - atan(x[i])) <= 1e-6 required for every element; one violating value decides the single global verdict."}], "scope_rationale": "Large-|x| values (up to +/-65504) and values near the 2.4142 and 0.66 branch boundaries are explicitly legal FP16 inputs under the contract, and the 1e-6 absolute bound applies to each of them.", "statement": "Inputs with large magnitude (upper branch, |x| > 2.414, up to 65504) or near the branch boundary values (FP16 values around 2.41421356 and around 0.66) produce output error exceeding 1e-6 due to pi/2 + small-local_angle FP32 addition and branch-approximation mismatch."}

message.reasoning_content: Record claims: worst-case accuracy of rounded coefficients exceeding 1e-6 (in_scope), branch-boundary values, subnormal/extremes fine? The accuracy claim is primary. Also -0.0 signed zero fine per contract. Record 2 claims.
